_comment: Own ideas 200 from the master plan, batch 2. Read by scripts/core/FineTraining.gd (1114), ChallengeRules.gd (1112), NewGamePlus.gd (1111) and TowerWeek.gd (1103).

fine_training.scam_line: Coach Varro pockets the coins and says the gains are 'internal'. Nothing changed.
fine_training.done_line: Coach Varro: Feel that? That's %s getting meaner. Pleasure doing business.

challenges.name: One Colour
challenges.text: Only Spirlings that share your starter's element may join the party.

challenges.name: Empty Pockets
challenges.text: No items in battle. Not even the cheap ones.

challenges.name: Off the Books
challenges.text: No shopping. Whatever you have, you found or stole.

challenges.name: Trust No One
challenges.text: After every Warden, one random party member walks off with a better offer.

ng_plus.start_line: Same streets, new faces. Everybody remembers you. Nobody admits it.

lines: The tower's landlord changed the rules again. Read the small print.
